title: 科技之外：工业材料里也有机会，分散配置为何关键？
speaker: Christina Moon

segments.en: So all things equal, does this tech remain the highest exposure as a share of allocations, and what about other sectors that have actually done well recently? I mean, you've talked about materials for one. I think financials have also done very, very well. How do you look at the entire pie now, Christina?
segments.zh: 那么，科技是否仍然是配置中占比最高的部分？其他近期表现不错的板块呢？比如你提到的材料，金融也表现很好。你现在如何看待整个配置组合？

segments.en: I think touching on that is also a really important point because a lot of the investor's minds focus lies in tech, but you can't possibly put all of your eggs in one basket. So for me, even though having tech as a higher-conviction part of our strategies is important, I think what the last month has really shown us or has really come through is the important of diversification.
segments.zh: 这确实很重要，因为很多投资者关注科技，但不能把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。对我来说，虽然科技是我们策略中高确信度的部分，但过去一个月真正体现的是分散配置的重要性。

segments.en: So materials, for example, or industrials, have been great areas to find truffles in. These tend to be, I suppose, less efficient sectors, just because people don't look at them as much, but I mean, there are quite a number of good drivers within there that could be positive as well.
segments.zh: 例如材料或工业，都是寻找机会的好领域。这些板块效率较低，因为关注的人不多，但里面有很多积极的驱动因素。

segments.en: I mean, if you're like AI, for example, many of the power names within industrials play into that, but perhaps don't get as much attention as the tech sector. Within materials, we saw quite a big sell-off as well, well, actually for the most part
segments.zh: 比如AI，工业中的许多电力相关公司参与其中，但可能没有科技板块那么受关注。材料板块也经历了大幅抛售，实际上大部分……
